policy: Only these repository-specific values may differ. Existing aliases and historical records remain compatible. Unknown or conflicting values block the affected operation; implementers must not add policy exceptions.

shared.newLocalRemovalSemantics: One exact published checkout; preflight before detach, execute outside it, retain local branch and remote resources. Concrete adapter wiring uses the compatible released A1 interface; missing support blocks rather than substitutes another operation.
shared.contractCheckSemantics: Read identical cases, bind local implementations, assert observed effects, compare all deployed contract files with approved planning bytes and SHA-256 digests. Do not fetch the companion repository during ordinary offline operations.

a1.acceptanceBinding: Exact finalized version-3 head, archive and conditional acceptance manifest matching the PR's plain acceptance scenarios; preserve legacy readers.
a1.privatePreservation: Preserve all unknown/private/KEEP/nested/unpublished content under the existing cleanup gates.

xrbuild.acceptanceBinding: Existing finalized version-1 change/archive association and applicable plain acceptance evidence; do not import the version-3 manifest format or rewrite historical/in-progress records.
xrbuild.privatePreservation: Preserve ignored independent .xrbuild workspaces and .artifacts/KEEP in addition to all shared preservation gates; never provision or export private data implicitly.

activationNote: These values preserve the reviewed activation profile; each remote mutation still verifies current authoritative state. Disagreement is a blocker, not permission to apply settings. This contract does not activate a workflow or change branch protection.
commandNote: Entrypoint locations and existing runtime commands are bindings, not authority. New implementation function names and exact-target option parsing may differ internally, but may not alter the shared rules or expected cases. In particular, the old xrbuild sweep declaration must not remain an exact-completion substitute.
